item.title: Hubble 1.0.6
item.description:
Hubble 1.0.6
Hubble 1.0.6: automatic Companion setup and configuration compatibility
- Set up the Hubble module from Service Settings with Install in Companion: enable Developer Modules, configure the module folder, and add or reuse the matching Hubble connection on supported Companion 4.3+ and 5.x versions. - Preserve variables, field layouts, and clipboard data when transferring configurations, and improve loading and resending configurations from earlier releases. - Preserve legacy LiveGrade slot behavior when importing older configurations. - Hide Ross SW-P-08 from new connection setup and reject new additions while keeping existing configurations usable.
